lines.reference: Sweet potato, raw, unprepared — USDA FDC 168482: 86 kcal / 100 g
Onions, raw — USDA FDC 170000: 40 kcal / 100 g
Oil, olive, salad or cooking — USDA FDC 171413: 884 kcal / 100 g
Spices, paprika (smoked paprika is the same per gram) — USDA FDC 171329: 282 kcal / 100 g
Spices, pepper, black — USDA FDC 170931: 251 kcal / 100 g
Broccoli, raw — USDA FDC 170379: 34 kcal / 100 g

Wholegrain mustard: no SR Legacy entry; branded label (Beaufor, USDA Branded Foods UPC 888513932977, nutritionvalue.org) 10 kcal per 5 g, rounded; used 155 kcal, P 7.5, F 10.5, net carbs 5 / 100 g, in the range of European wholegrain mustard labels
Lemon juice, raw — USDA FDC 167747: 22 kcal / 100 g; Lemon peel, raw (for lemon or lime zest) — USDA FDC 167749: 47 kcal / 100 g
Garlic, raw — USDA FDC 169230: 149 kcal / 100 g
Fish, salmon, Atlantic, farmed, raw — USDA FDC 175167: 208 kcal / 100 g
Lemon juice, raw — USDA FDC 167747: 22 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions that change the number: farmed Atlantic salmon at USDA values, 150 g skin-on a person with the skin counted (trout would be ~100 kcal less a serving); 175 g peeled sweet potato each; all 2 tbsp oil eaten; wholegrain mustard from a label. Published check: salmon with sweet potato and broccoli traybakes are typically listed at ~550–650 kcal; 620 agrees.
